title: WARREN ANDERSON
en: The man responsible for thousands of deaths left the country the same day.
7 December 1984. Union Carbide's chairman, Warren Anderson, arrived in Bhopal.
But he was held for only a few hours, at the company's guest house.
He got bail the same day, and was flown out on a government plane.
He never came back to face trial.
The court declared him an absconder. He died in the USA in 2014.
Most of the victims received only 25,000 rupees,
